title: Respond to an evidence request
responsibility: Route authenticated evidence reads to JSON or attested media responses.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceRead.context
inputs.description: Actor, route project ID, request and projection service.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceRead.operation
inputs.description: evidence selects the JSON evidence read; every other value selects the artifact path.

outputs.name: hubEvidenceRead
outputs.description: 405 method-denied JSON for non-GET requests, otherwise evidence JSON or artifact bytes with no-store and no-sniff headers and the attested media type.
